title: All Smiles
description: A young harbor seal (Phoca vitulina) approaches a diver near the Hopkins Marine Station in Monterey, California. Seals are known for their curious and playful demeanor, but they can also easily become stressed with unexpected human interaction. The presence of these marine animals typically indicates a healthy habitat, as they consume fish that are vulnerable to pollution, in turn regulating their populations.
translated_description: 一只年轻的港海豹（Phoca vitulina）在加利福尼亚州蒙特雷的霍普金斯海洋站附近靠近一名潜水员。海豹以其好奇和顽皮的天性而闻名，但意外的与人类互动也容易使它们感到压力。这些海洋动物的出现通常意味着栖息地健康，因为它们以易受污染影响的鱼类为食，从而调节这些鱼类的种群数量。
